affected_subject.reason: Identifies swap/multihop functions in Router.sol lacking deadline parameter.

trigger_or_action.reason: Transaction sits in mempool and executes later under changed market conditions.

direct_effect.reason: User receives only minimum slippage amount at stale price, e.g. 0.83 WETH instead of 1 WETH.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected deadline-bounded execution vs actual unbounded execution; comparison to correct swapExactTokensForTokens deadline behavior.

summary: Report identifies affected Router.sol swap functions, the stale-transaction trigger, concrete unfavorable execution effect, and a deadline-based expected-vs-actual safety relation.
